premises: A buyer cannot directly evaluate an outcome that remains abstract.
A tailored preview makes part of the proposed outcome observable before purchase.
derivation: A bounded preview may reduce the buyer's uncertainty about relevance and seller capability without requiring a full delivery.
prediction: Some buyers who ignore a generic pitch will request a next step after seeing a relevant, accurate preview.
falsifier: Target buyers understand accurate previews but do not take a next step more often than they do after a plain description.
